summary: Busy Taringa Parade lane near a junction, no parking, nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Main road with turn lanes, no parked cars
Marked bus or cycle lane at kerb
Homes 20 m away across the road

drivers.seclusion: Bush and footpath on the west side; homes 20 m and 25 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a marked lane beside a footpath; no bay or verge to pull fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy road with a junction and turn arrows, noisy.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the kerb; only moving traffic seen.

sun_shade: Bush shades the kerb from the west in the afternoon; open to morning sun.
cannot_judge: Exact meaning of the dashed lane markings
